Candidate only; Stage B checksum gate remains active. Berberine-sulfate calibration mass-expression is not explicitly resolved, so retain source-reported concentration as method-specific estimate; an additional yellow alkaloid band was observed. Commercial dried sample source was an herbal-products retailer; wild sample is a single field collection. Three analytical replicates are not independent biological replicates.
